title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist (Viator)
description:

The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

As our new Senior Machine Learning Scientist you’ll be joining the Viator R&D Team. This team is evolving the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About the Role 

You’ll serve as a key technical lead and pod architect within our core discovery engine. You will independently own and execute the machine learning strategy for major product capabilities—such as Search, Retrieval, Ranking, or Content AI—that power how millions of users discover and plan their travel itineraries.

This Senior Machine Learning Scientist role bridges the gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) research and robust, production-grade engineering. You will navigate technical ambiguity, implement custom algorithmic components, and explicitly map offline model metrics directly to business KPIs like booking conversion and user engagement. If you are a relentlessly curious scientist who excels at rapid prototyping, practical SOTA deployment, and multiplying the capabilities of your peers, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do 

- Technical Leadership & Custom Implementation: Act as the technical lead for specific ML projects within your pod. Design and implement custom model components or loss functions that don't exist "off-the-shelf," breaking down massive research goals into deliverable, iterative milestones.

- Optimization & SOTA Scouting: Evaluate the global research landscape to conduct cost-benefit analyses on new architectures, balancing model complexity against inference speed, memory usage, and execution costs (such as token consumption). Optimize models for production using techniques like quantization and distillation.

- Operational Frameworks & Rigor: Tailor Golden Datasets and leaderboards with minimal supervision, and implement rigorous validation automation (such as backtesting and slice-based evaluation) to prevent data leakage, over-fitting, and production regressions.

- Engineering Partnership & Handovers: Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads to ensure compute/GPU infrastructure supports model requirements. Clearly define model failure modes, edge cases, and confidence thresholds—to enable SWE partners to build robust fallback systems.

- Applied Debugging & Guardrails: Diagnose complex algorithmic bugs and implement automated checks for "Silent Failures" (e.g., concept drift or production feature distribution shifts). Lead team-level post-mortems and resolve blocking corrective actions.

- Career Multiplier: Formally mentor mid-level and associate ML scientists, reviewing their experimental logic to ensure high scientific rigor while guiding them through applied ML and production constraints.

Skills & Experience 

- Education: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.

- Experience: 5+ years of industry experience developing, validating, and deploying large-scale ML models in production environments.

title: Backend Engineering Intern: Ground Platform Control
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Backend Engineering Intern to join our Ground Platform, Control Team. The Control team owns the backend services that let Loft operators and customers command, monitor, and automate our satellite fleet through Cockpit, our mission control system. You'll help build and scale the microservices that sit between ground and flight software, turning high-level intent into safe, reliable on-orbit operations. Our team sits in the middle of Flight Software, Satellite Operations, and Test teams, giving you the chance to learn about the full end-to-end systems that go into launching and operating a satellite mission. If you're excited about building backend systems that directly control satellites — and you like the idea of both shipping code and helping fly missions — we'd love to hear from you.

Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.

About this role: 
Your task will be to design and develop a control investigation API which will assist operators with investigations and enable the automation of standard investigations into failed commanding and lack of telemetry. This will be a valuable step towards reliable and scalable operations of our fleet. The project will require you to work closely with our satellite operators to learn about common failure cases, as well as our space infrastructure, to understand how it can best be used to automate investigations.

Must Haves: 

- An engineering background (e.g. Computer Science, Physics, Aerospace) with a desire to do back-end software engineering.

- Python experience.

- Comfortable working in English: the Control team works across the US and France, so it's essential you can communicate well in English.

- A desire to work in a diverse, international team.

- Good communication skills.

Nice to Haves: 

- Experience with Docker and container-based development.

- Knowledge of space systems and/or an understanding of satellite operations.

- Hands-on experience with backend web development frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI, etc.).

- Database fundamentals.

- Knowledge of front-end engineering practices and frameworks.

Challenge: 
As part of the interview process, you may be asked to write a short Python notebook to demonstrate your coding approach and problem‐solving mindset.

What Can We Offer? 
You will join the Ground Platform Control team and work on backend systems with direct application to Loft's satellite operations, under the mentorship of our engineers — with the possibility of a full-time hire after the internship if all goes well. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, USA | Golden, USA | and Toulouse, France.

Some of our awesome internship benefits:

- Gratification: €1,300 gross/month.

- Lunch vouchers (tickets restaurant), because let's be honest, we love food! (we even have a Slack channel about it: #loft-gourmand)

- Sustainable mobility package (forfait mobilité durable).

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. 

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

Success in this role means improving platform reliability, reducing operational friction, strengthening automation, and helping teams resolve issues quickly and sustainably.

What You'll Do 

Your day-to-day 

- You’ll administer and support Databricks workspaces, cluster policies, compute configurations, jobs, workflows, libraries, service principals, permissions, and platform integrations. 

- You’ll support Unity Catalog, including access governance, catalog and schema permissions, and secure data sharing.

- You’ll participate in on-call support and lead investigation, mitigation, recovery, communication, and root-cause analysis for production incidents. 

- You’ll build and maintain infrastructure and automation using Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Git, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and scripting.

Why Join Us?

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 

Are you ready to be part of the future? 

About the job 

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction. 

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. 

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

- Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. 

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. 

- Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. 

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

title: Software Engineer, Backend (Platform)
description:
Valinor is a new type of defense and government tech company focused on solving the problems others don't. Our unique model of centralized go-to-market and decentralized engineering allows us to move with unparalleled efficiency to identify unmet needs, build right-sized solutions, and get products where they matter most - in the hands of users. Unlike others in the space, who focus on the flashy problems, Valinor exists to solve the quiet, unaddressed problems-the small but significant ones that lead to cracks in the country's strength, stability, and security.

Backed by General Catalyst, Founders Fund, and Friends & Family Capital, Valinor was founded in 2024 and has established strategic partnerships with Palantir, Anduril, and Helsing. We are building the dream team, and we want you on it.

About The Role 

Valinor Streamline is looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help build and evolve the backend systems and foundational infrastructure behind our growing platform. You'll join a small, highly collaborative team with significant ownership over the technical foundation of the product and the decisions that shape it as we grow.

We're looking for someone who has built software that real customers depend on and understands what it takes to improve and scale those systems while keeping them running. This role is ideal for a strong backend engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, isn't afraid to get into the weeds with infrastructure, and is excited to help shape a product at an early stage.

What You'll Do 

- 
Design, build, and maintain the backend services and foundational platform components that power Streamline's products and enable other engineers to ship high quality software.

- 
Own and execute complex migrations and architectural improvements to production systems while maintaining reliability and minimizing disruption to customers.

- 
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend systems, improving how data is accessed, processed, and delivered as the platform scales.

- 
Own technical problems end-to-end, from architectural design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.

- 
Work closely with a small engineering team to make pragmatic technical decisions, balance immediate product needs with long-term scalability, and help shape the technical direction of the platform.

What We're Looking For 

- 
6+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong foundation in backend development and a track record of building and operating production systems.

- 
Deep understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, databases, caching, and performance optimization.

- 
Experience evolving complex production systems, including executing migrations and making architectural changes without compromising reliability or availability.

- 
Experience working in engineering environments where scalability, performance, and reliability are critical, ideally at a growing startup or established technology company.

- 
Strong programming skills and comfort working across backend services and infrastructure

- 
Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate complex codebases, design thoughtful abstractions, and evaluate tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and maintainability.

- 
A builder's mentality, intellectual curiosity, and comfort taking ownership in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment. Experience founding a company, building independent projects, or working at an early-stage startup is a plus.

What Valinor Offers 

- 
Competitive salary, equity packages, and benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance - fully covered for employees, 401(k), development stipends, among others.

- 
Unlimited PTO and two-week company holiday at the end of every calendar year.

- 
We are a pro-mental health and pro-family company - we actually encourage employees to spend time with themselves and their families. Valinor also provides fertility benefits to those just beginning that journey.

- 
Fun work environment - we like to laugh and take care of each other, but we also deeply respect the mission in front of us.

Valinor is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Compliance & Recording
description:
About Us 

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.

Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.

Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team 

The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams.

Our customers include 8 of the world's 10 largest banks. They rely on us for a complete, auditable record of every regulated call and message, so reliability and precision are at the heart of everything the team builds. We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own how recorded communications are captured, delivered and analysed. This is an API-first, backend role: there is little UI at its core, because for our customers the integration is the product.

About the Role 

You will lead product strategy and delivery for Compliance & Recording, from the APIs and delivery channels that move recorded data into customer environments to the AI capabilities we build on top of it. 

- Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance & Recording, covering customer-managed (on-site) recording, Cloud Compliance and the integrations that connect them to customer systems.
- Define and evolve how recorded voice, SMS and data reach customers through APIs, SFTP, SMTP and S3 bucket pushes, choosing the right mechanism for each use case.
- Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria.
- Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout.
- Define and track success metrics such as delivery success rate, latency, capture completeness and time to integrate, and keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory change and the competitive landscape.
Requirements 

About You 

Must Have 

- 6+ years in product management, with end-to-end ownership of API-first, backend or platform products where there is little or no UI.
- Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs: REST design, authentication, versioning, webhooks, pagination, error handling and idempotency. You read OpenAPI specs, test endpoints yourself and hold your own in design discussions with engineers.
- Solid understanding of file and message-based integrations such as SFTP, SMTP and object storage (for example AWS S3), including batch versus near real-time delivery, encryption and access control.

title: AI Growth Engineer
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview 

As Cresta’s Growth Engineer, you’ll build the technical surface of how Cresta goes to market. You’ll develop custom AI agents on Cresta’s own platform for marketing use cases, build the interactive experiences and tooling our growth team runs on, and own cresta.com. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities 

AI Agent Creation

- Build the agent experiences prospects actually touch — event registration, demo and trial surfaces, and the moments where someone would rather just ask Cresta a question.

- Integrate agents with the systems behind them — CRM, marketing automation, event tooling — so a conversation produces a real downstream action.

- Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams: identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

Growth Experimentation and Tooling

title: Principal Software Engineer | Data Science
description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.


Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 


Position Summary 


ExtraHop is at the forefront of innovation in the cybersecurity space, delivering cutting-edge solutions to protect organizations against evolving threats. Our Network Detection and Response (NDR) products empower businesses to detect, respond to, and mitigate cyber risks in real time.


We seek a Principal Software Engineer to join our product development organization and serve as a technical anchor on our NDR platform. In this role, you will drive the architecture and execution of complex, high-impact engineering initiatives that define the future of our products. You will operate with significant autonomy, influence engineering direction across teams, and mentor engineers at multiple levels while delivering software that addresses the most sophisticated challenges in network security.


Key Responsibilities 



- Design, write, and maintain robust, high-performance software to deploy AI/ML models that analyze network traffic for anomalous or malicious behaviors.

- Design and develop autonomous AI agent architectures and multi-agent workflows. 

- Collaborate with data scientists, threat researchers, and cloud teams to build high-performance services, pipelines, and tooling that accelerate ML experimentation and production workflows. 

- Drive engineering excellence across teams through code reviews, design reviews, and the establishment of standards, patterns, and best practices.

- Lead cross-functional technical initiatives and represent engineering in conversations with senior leadership and external stakeholders.

- Contribute to product strategy by bringing deep technical insight to roadmap discussions, build-vs-buy decisions, and competitive differentiation.

- Lead by example. Provide technical mentorship to software engineers on the team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, optimization, and rigorous engineering discipline. 


Required Qualifications 



- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in Principal, Lead, or Staff capacity shipping enterprise-grade software. 

- Expert-level programming skills in Python and Go, with an emphasis on writing production-quality, well-tested, and modular code.

- Experience in machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.

- Experience building or operating production AI/ML systems, including model lifecycle management, data/training pipelines, and monitoring.

- Expertise in applying machine learning or data science techniques to cybersecurity use cases such as anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, or threat classification.

- Advanced understanding of threat detection methodologies, intrusion prevention systems, and incident response workflows.


Preferred Qualifications 



- A strong fundamental understanding of network telemetry and protocols.

- Prior experience working in the cybersecurity domain. Familiarity with threat actor techniques and common network attack vectors.

- Familiarity with machine learning applications in cybersecurity.

- Understanding of threat detection, intrusion prevention, and incident response strategies.

- Deep experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure.

- Deep experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes at production scale.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences at the executive level.


The salary range for this role is $175,000 - $198,000 + bonus + benefits 


ABOUT EXTRAHOP 


ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.


This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.


OUR VALUES 


Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. 


Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.


Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. 


Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.


Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.


Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. 


BENEFITS 


Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:



- Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

- Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

- Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan

- FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable

- Educational Reimbursement

- 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

- Pet Insurance (US Only)

- Parental Leave (US Only)

- Hybrid and Remote Work Model


Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today! 


To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn .

title: AI Developer
description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

- Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
- Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
- Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
- Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
- Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
- Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.
DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
- Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
- Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
- Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
- Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).

- 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
- Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
- Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
- DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
- Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

title: Senior AI Developer, Data
description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent , our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

At Workleap, turning AI experiments into production capabilities is already part of how we build products and improve internal operations. Our Data team brings strong data engineering and science foundations; this role adds dedicated production AI engineering. As a Senior AI Developer, you'll design, build, and operate the AI systems and agentic workflows that connect foundation models to our data, tools, and applications, and you'll set the technical direction for how we do it well.

Your impact: 

- Ship production AI systems and agentic workflows that deliver measurable value in Workleap's products and internal operations.

- Own the production quality of those systems: observability, testing, security, and cost built in from the start.

- Turn evaluation evidence from Data Scientists into engineering improvements, so we know whether a system is getting better or worse.

- Engineer the context integrations that let agents use governed data and application capabilities accurately.

- Define reusable patterns and components so the next team starts from a working foundation, not a blank page.

- Drive architecture decisions across quality, risk, and cost, and make the trade-offs explicit.

Your team

You'll join Workleap's Shared Tech - Data team , a hands-on team of six Data Engineers and Data Scientists responsible for the data and AI foundations supporting our products and internal teams. We value technical judgment, pragmatism, simplicity, autonomy, collaboration, and reliable delivery . You'll work closely with both disciplines and partner with Software Engineers, Product teams, and Platform and Security specialists to bring AI capabilities into production.

Over the next 6-12 months, you'll work on questions like: how does someone ask an analytical question of governed data and get an answer they can trust? How do we know an AI agent is good enough to take on more responsibility? How do we run AI features with the same rigor as any other critical system?

Our technology ecosystem includes Python, SQL, Snowflake (Cortex, Cortex Agents, Cortex Code), Claude, OpenAI, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Terraform, and GitHub .

What you'll bring

- Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, with testing, CI/CD, and experience operating cloud systems;

- Hands-on experience building and operating AI applications with foundation models, agents, tools, and context;

- Experience instrumenting and evaluating non-deterministic systems: observability, evals, regression testing;

- Sound architectural judgment across reliability, security, and cost, and the confidence to form and defend a technical opinion;

- Experience building components or tooling that other developers adopt;

- Working knowledge of Snowflake and its AI capabilities (Cortex), or the ability to ramp up on them quickly;

- A builder mindset: you own what you ship, experiment quickly, and use AI-assisted development tools daily and critically;

- Bonus: AI services on Azure, AWS, or GCP, or developer platforms that accelerate AI adoption across teams.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

- Base salary: $140 000 - $170 000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.

- Annual bonus program.

- LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.

- RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.

- Flexible vacation policy.

- Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.

- In-person gatherings twice a year.

- Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us 

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire 

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy .

All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis 

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate 

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions , each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role 

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

- Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

- Own the system end to end : infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

- Ensure production-grade quality , performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

- Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities 

- Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

- Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

- Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

- Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

- Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For 

- 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

- Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

- Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

- Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

- Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

- Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis .

- Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have 

- Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

- GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

- Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

- NLP background

Why Join Us 

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

- Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

- Real-world impact : your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

- High ownership : own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

- A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: 

Team 

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis . They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12 : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win 

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet 

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability ; parametric tools only check constraints after generation , leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. 

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

- Practical and real-world experience working with databases and cloud environments.

- Experience in infraestructure working with Kubernetes (or similar platforms)

- Experience with automation, CI and CD

- Experience building software collaboratively using pull requests and code reviews

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

- Professional proficiency in English.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)

- Hands-on experience working with Golang

- Hands-on experience in the Frontend working with React 

Benefits & Perks: 

- Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 

- Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! 

- Flexible Time Off Package - We offer a flexible annual leave policy plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.

- Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in USD) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.

- Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.

- Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.

- 401k - We offer a 401k plan and match up to 4%, with no minimum entry requirements and immediate vesting of employers’ contributions.

Our Interview Process 

- Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

- Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your Python expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.

- Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities 

- Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

- Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

- Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

- Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

- Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

- Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

- Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

- Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

- Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us? 

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.

Qualifications:

- BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

- Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

- Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

- Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

- Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

- Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

- Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

- Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

- Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

- An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

- Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

- Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

- Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

- Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

- Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

- Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

- Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

- Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

- Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance: 

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

- Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.

- Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.

- Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.

- Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.

- Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.

- Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

- You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.

- You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.

- You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.

- You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.

- You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.

- You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.

If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

- Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.

- Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe.

- Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target.

Why join us

Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation.

Tensordyne Values

- Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals.

- Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver.

- Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results.

- Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful.

- Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective.

- Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. 

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence

Headquarters: New Jersey, USA

URL: https://vertican.com 

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required 

- 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.

- Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.

- Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.

- Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.

- You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.

- Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.

- Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.

- Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have 

- Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.

- Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.

- Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.

- Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.

- Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

- A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.

Wheely is redefining premium transportation across major cities in Europe, the US, and the Middle East. We blend cutting-edge technology with the craft of five-star chauffeuring to deliver an experience trusted by more than 100,000 active riders and 1,200 corporate accounts.

title: Senior Electronics Engineer
description:
FULL-TIME | 5 DAYS ON-SITE

LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK

FIELD TRAVEL: AS REQUIRED

THE LAST FRONTIER 

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE 
We’re looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to design, build, and test all electrical systems within ARD’s product stack. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware, software, and real-world deployment making an impact at every layer – from the PCB to Arctic field tests. You’ll move fast and take end-to-end ownership of the electronic architecture you’ll build, ensuring seamless operation in the harshest climate on Earth. You will be involved at all stages of electronics development and a key member of the engineering team at our early company stage.

* Please note: this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship * 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Architect, build, and iterate embedded systems from first principles - including MCUs, PCBs, physical comms modules, and ARD’s custom subsystems

- Own electrical integration across ARD’s full stack, optimising for SWaP-C at every iteration

- Serve as the go-to technical lead across electrical, RF, systems, and mechanical interfaces

- Work tightly with deployment, software, and systems teams to ship field-ready hardware

- Get hands-on in field – travel to Arctic test sites and client installations

REQUIREMENTS 

- 6+ years of hands-on experience building electronics for real world systems and completing projects from the requirements stage through design, prototype and to production

- An understanding across all areas of electronics - you'll be comfortable dealing with microcontrollers as well as RF circuits and DC/DC converters

- Exposure to battery powered platforms including BMS and DC/DC power supply design is a real advantage

- Good understanding of mixed signal board design including microcontrollers, sensors, ethernet, SPI, I2C etc

- Proven track record designing & debugging high-density, high-reliability PCBs for harsh environments

- Confident getting hands on soldering, prototyping & field testing under pressure

- Willingness to learn quickly and push your limits in a fast paced environment

- Self-driven, able to work effectively within a startup environment

- Field ready: able to travel as required to test product in the field

Future Security Clearance Requirements 

As our business scales into the defence and security sectors, the responsibilities of this role are expected to evolve to include projects requiring UK Security Check (SC) clearance .

While an active clearance is not required to apply or start in this role, candidates must be willing and eligible to undergo UK Government security vetting in the future should project requirements dictate it.

To meet the standard eligibility criteria for UK standard SC vetting, you must typically have resided in the UK for the past 5 continuous years , hold a valid passport, and be capable of passing comprehensive background, financial, and criminal record checks.

WHAT WE OFFER 

- Competitive compensation

- Private Health Insurance from Day 1

- Dental & Vision

- Equity - meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

- Real field exposure - travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed

- Mission-driven culture - focus on impact, not hours logged
