title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Opportunity 

We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.

The Problems You'll Get to Solve 

- Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget.

- Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise

- Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection.

- Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.

- Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.

What You'll Be Doing 

- Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.

- Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.

- Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.

- Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.

- Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.

What We Look For 

- Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.

- Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.

- A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.

- Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.

- Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.

- Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.

Nice to have:

- Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate. 

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

Scripting & Programming: Proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, or Go for automation and tooling.
IaC & CI/CD: Demonstrated mastery of Terraform, GitOps workflows, and automated testing/deployment pipelines.
AI Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with GPU node provisioning, distributed storage for massive datasets, and model serving runtimes.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Ray Serve, vLLM).
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer 

Sydney or Melbourne (Hybrid)

About Nash 

Nash is building the digital logistics infrastructure that powers delivery for some of the world’s largest retailers, tech platforms, and delivery services. Our platform connects merchants, carriers, and customers through unified AI-driven logistics, helping enterprises like Walmart, Woolworths, 7-Eleven, and Coles orchestrate millions of deliveries every month.

We’re now expanding our engineering presence in Australia and looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who can ship code, solve real customer problems, and help shape how Nash scales across APAC.

The Role 

This is hands-on engineering at the edge — not pre-sales, not implementation. You’ll build, deploy, and operate production software directly with customers while working closely with our global product and AI teams.

You’ll be part of the foundational team defining how our Australia engineering office operates. Expect to move fast, own outcomes, and see your work drive real-world impact within weeks, not quarters.

What You’ll Do 

• Build and deploy production systems used by top enterprise retailers

• Work directly with customers’ engineering, ops, and leadership teams

• Take new products from concept to live deployments

• Design and extend core infrastructure underpinning global delivery orchestration

• Partner with product and AI teams to influence direction across APAC

• Debug real-world logistics workflows across fleets, APIs, and integrations

Who You Are 

• 4 plus years building and shipping production software

• Strong experience with APIs, backend systems, or platform integrations

• Comfortable jumping between code, customer problems, and architecture decisions

• Bias toward speed, iteration, and ownership

• Clear communicator who can work directly with operators, CTOs, and execs

• Motivated by building software that touches the physical world at scale

Why This Role 

If you’ve wanted to join a high-velocity YC-backed startup redefining how logistics works worldwide — while getting to build and see your code operate inside real enterprise workflows — this is the one.

Your work will touch millions of deliveries each month and help define Nash’s engineering footprint across APAC.

More about Nash 

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. 

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us 

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery

Job Description 

Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics. 

What you’ll be doing 

- Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.

- Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.

- Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.

- Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.

- Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).

- Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.

- Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.

- Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

What you must have 

- Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.

- A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.

- Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).

- Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).

- Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.

- Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.

- Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

Get some bonus points 

- PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.

- Publications at top-tier conferences.

- Experience in managing a software team.

- Ability to write production-level code in modern C++

RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.

We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:

- 
Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;

- 
Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;

- 
Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;

- 
Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;

Key Requirements

- 
You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- 
You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)

- 
Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence

- 
A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.

- 
You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.

- 
Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;

- 
Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;

- 
You have security or risk control experience as a plus.

- 
You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.

- 
English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Why Join Us 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

- Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

- Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.

- MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Principal Software Engineer who is passionate about continuous learning and eager to grow along with us in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

You will work remotely from Bulgaria and will be reporting to an engineering leader located in Bulgaria.

You Will: 

- Lead the design and implementation of Smartsheet's next-generation architecture, ensuring scalability, security, and performance for millions of global users.

- Define and drive architecture strategy, making key technical decisions that shape the future of the platform.

- Review and guide technical project designs, providing feedback during design review presentations to ensure system resilience and scalability.

- Take ownership of cross-functional technical initiatives, aligning teams around common architectural goals while driving large-scale projects to completion.

- Foster strong technical leadership, mentoring senior engineers and influencing best practices across multiple engineering teams.

- Lead deployment reviews for high-impact projects, ensuring they meet scalability, performance, and security requirements.

- Collaborate closely with product management and other business stakeholders to balance market needs with technical constraints, driving innovation while maintaining technical rigor.

- Advocate for quality and operational excellence, ensuring systems are monitored, tested, and maintained to meet the highest reliability standards.

- Perform other duties as assigned.

You Have: 

- Proven experience in system architecture and the design of scalable, high-availability systems across multiple programming languages and frameworks (Python, Go, Java, C/C++, SQL).

- Deep understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and microservices.

- Strong experience in leading large-scale architectural transformations, with the ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams.

- Expertise in web application development, data structures, and object-oriented design.

- A track record of mentoring senior engineers, leading them through architectural challenges, and ensuring they grow into strong technical leaders.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives.

- Experience with cloud architectures and infrastructure at scale, as well as database optimization for performance and scalability.

- Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, driving initiatives forward while aligning with business objectives.

- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, driving engineering best practices across teams.

- Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis.

- Fluency in English is required.

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

Get to Know Us: 

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. 

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

title: CDI - Manager Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
description:
Mission 

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent. 

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités 

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités : 

- Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.

- Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.

- Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.

- Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.

- Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.

- Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché 

Les indispensables : 

- Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.

- Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.

- Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.

- La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.

- Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- Python pour le traitement de données.

- Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.

- Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.

- La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.

- Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement 

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 10 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

Dit ga je doen:

- Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren.

- Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties.

- Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht.

- Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen.

- Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren.

- Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

Team 
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.

De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026. 

Dit vragen we: 

⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component.

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste.

⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist.

⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken.

⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten.

⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden.

Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position.

description:
Biobase | Senior Technical Product Engineer, Technical Product Engineer (Early Career) | REMOTE (US, Canada) | Full-time | $150–230k / $90–170k + equity Biobase has grand ambitions. We broker biospecimens, whole slide images, and the clinical metadata attached to them, on a supply-chain backbone that we're steadily automating. We’re building healthcare-data-focused agents on top of the datasets that we’re assembling, too. We'd rather build the thing that removes the work than throw people at it. Two roles, one team, both reporting to the CPO: Senior Technical Product Engineer ($150–230k + meaningful equity).

title: Data Engineer III - FMX
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

Data Engineer III 

About the Role 
We're looking for a Data Engineer III to join our Data Engineering team, which builds and governs the data foundation that powers the business. You'll work within our stack — Python ingestion pipelines, Airflow orchestration, and Snowflake/Databricks — helping move data reliably and securely from source to decision-ready output.
You'll implement features and fixes against a given design, handle known classes of pipeline issues on your own, and escalate genuinely novel problems with clear context rather than working them in isolation. You're also expected to start contributing meaningfully in code review — catching real bugs, not just style nits.

What You'll Do 

- Implement new ingestion sources end-to-end against a senior engineer's design — connector code, DAG, schema, monitoring, and catalog registration — extending the team's existing framework where a new source needs a pattern it doesn't yet support

- Investigate pipeline failures independently, recognize known classes of issues, and ship the documented fix without needing to escalate

- Before shipping a new pipeline, identify downstream consumers and what would break if data were late or wrong, and flag gaps like this during spec review — before writing code

- Write clear handovers when escalating a genuinely unresolved issue — what you tried, what you ruled out, and where things diverge — so a senior can pick up without re-discovery

- Review peers' pipeline PRs and catch non-obvious issues (e.g., missing idempotency checks, race conditions) that could cause incorrect downstream data

- Turn ambiguous "why is this data wrong?" questions into structured investigations — tracing data lineage from source to warehouse and communicating back what you found

- Surface concerns in spec review as specific, well-reasoned questions rather than staying silent or blocking progress

- Support data security and governance work (e.g., PII masking, access controls) and contribute to data delivery work, including reverse ETL integrations

- Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and help scope and clarify requirements for new work

- Mentor DE2s on their first significant projects — pairing on tricky decisions and helping them apply team conventions

What We're Looking For 

- 3–5 years of professional software or data engineering experience

- Strong SQL and Python skills, with solid experience building and operating production data pipelines

- Comfort investigating and root-causing pipeline issues independently before escalating

- Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow or similar) and a cloud data warehouse/lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar)

- Solid understanding of data pipeline concepts: idempotency, schema evolution, backfills, and data quality/testing

- Experience giving substantive code review feedback, not just style or formatting comments

- Strong communication skills — can write a clear technical handover, ask sharp questions in spec review, and explain a data lineage investigation to a non-technical stakeholder

- A track record of taking ownership of known-class problems end-to-end rather than needing step-by-step direction

Nice to Have 

- Experience extending or building reusable pipeline frameworks/templates

- Exposure to reverse ETL tools or patterns, PII masking, or data access governance (RBAC)

- Exposure to observability/monitoring tooling (e.g., Datadog) for pipeline health and alerting

- Some experience mentoring or informally supporting more junior engineers

- Background in gaming, betting, e-commerce, or another regulated/high-compliance industry

Why Join Us 

- Real ownership over known-class problems, with senior/staff support available for the genuinely novel ones

- Work on high-visibility, high-trust systems that the business depends on

- A culture built around clear tenets: standardize before you scale, own the outcome (not just the ticket), and clarity over complexity

- Clear growth path into Senior Data Engineer, with room to start mentoring and shaping team practices along the way

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES 

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

- Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

- Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

- Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). 

Vous bénéficierez de :

- 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

- flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

- télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

- Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

- Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

- A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026 

Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois 
Description de poste ici 
Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an 

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
description:

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. title: Forschungsprojektleiter:in Energiedaten & Gebäudetechnik (d/w/m)
description:
termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.

termios ist ein 2023 gegründetes Joint-Venture von mantro als Company Builder, dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen 

Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.

Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.

Du startest dabei nicht bei null: Wir haben bereits zwei vom BMWE geförderte Forschungsprojekte und sind in weiteren Forschungsfeldern aktiv. Für dieses wachsende Portfolio suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt jemanden, der Forschung nicht nur organisiert, sondern selbst betreibt.

Deine Aufgaben

- Studiendesign und Feldversuche: Du übersetzt offene Fragen in prüfbare Hypothesen und ein belastbares Studiendesign mit Vergleichsgruppen, Baseline, Witterungsbereinigung und Messkonzept. Messkampagnen in realen Liegenschaften setzt du gemeinsam mit Field Service und Anlagentechnik um.

- Datenanalyse: Du wertest Zeitreihen aus dem Gerätebestand und aus Messkampagnen selbst aus, quantifizierst Effekte und Unsicherheiten und trennst sauber zwischen Korrelation und Wirkung.

- Ergebnisse: Du bereitest Erkenntnisse für Abschlussberichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzen und Kunden auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie in unsere Algorithmen und Produktentwicklung zurückfließen.

- Projektleitung: Du steuerst mehrere parallel laufende Forschungs- und Pilotprojekte, von Arbeitspaketen und Meilensteinen über Budgets und Berichtspflichten bis zu Kooperationsverträgen, Datenschutz und Förderrichtlinien.

- Förderung und Akquise: Du findest passende Förderprogramme auf Landes-, Bundes- und EU-Ebene, entwickelst Projektideen mit Partnern und schreibst Skizzen und Anträge.

Das bringst du mit

- Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem ingenieur-, natur- oder datenwissenschaftlichen Fach, z. B. Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Bauphysik, Physik, Mathematik oder Informatik.

- Forschungserfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der angewandten Forschung gearbeitet, etwa an einem Fraunhofer-Institut, einer anderen Forschungseinrichtung, einer Hochschule oder in einer F&E-Abteilung, idealerweise im Umfeld Gebäude, Energie oder TGA.

- Methodik und Daten: Du hast Studien oder Messkampagnen selbst konzipiert und ausgewertet, wendest statistische Verfahren wie Regression, Zeitreihenanalyse und Hypothesentests sicher an und arbeitest dabei mit Python oder R sowie SQL.

- Projektleitung: Du hast Projekte mit mehreren Partnern geleitet oder koordiniert und bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen.

title: Staff Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.

In this position, you’ll 

- Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.

- Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.

- Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.

- Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.

- Turn siloed, team-level models into a coherent, calibrated detection system by addressing the technical and organisational barriers that lead to local optimisation.

- Identify and close detection coverage gaps, ensuring that relevant signals and outcomes are available for evaluation, diagnosis and continuous improvement.

- Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.

- Prototype critical components, test architectural assumptions empirically and build reference implementations that teams can scale.

- Explain complex ML trade-offs to senior technical and business leaders as clear choices about harm reduction, cost, and engineering investment.

About you 

- Have 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a similar role, including significant time owning production models or model evaluation at scale.

- Have led cross-team technical work without formal authority, and you're comfortable setting standards that other teams adopt.

- Have deep expertise in statistical inference and experimentation: A/B testing, measuring precision and recall under imperfect or biased labels, sampling for ground truth, and causal reasoning.

- Understand the ML lifecycle in production: evaluation, threshold setting, retraining, drift, feature stores and monitoring.

- Have hands-on experience evaluating LLM-based systems, or a strong interest in building rigorous methods for them.

- Are highly proficient in SQL and Python and comfortable working in a modern data stack (e.g. BigQuery, dbt).

- Can turn messy, cross-system problems into a clear plan, and can explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

- Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

- Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, content moderation, or risk management.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:

€107.000 — €144.800 EUR

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

- Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

- Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

- Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

- Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

- You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

- You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

- Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

- Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

- Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

- Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

- Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

- Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

- Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

title: Full Stack Web Engineer
description:
Location: Remote – Latin America (Open to applicants located anywhere in the LATAM region)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria's Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Full Stack Web Engineer at Fueled, your mission is to turn well-defined tickets and user stories into clean, production-ready code that powers large-scale digital experiences. Working within enterprise WordPress engagements, you'll build and deliver features end-to-end, from the frontend experience to modern PHP, JavaScript, and Gutenberg blocks in React.js. You'll bring designs and requirements to life within themes and plugins, moving quickly and confidently by pairing your own craft with AI-assisted workflows, thorough documentation, and the support of senior engineers who review and elevate your work.

This is a role for engineers who love the craft: you write code you're proud of, you welcome sharp code review, and you treat AI tools as a force multiplier, not a substitute for understanding. You should be comfortable taking a feature from requirements through implementation, making sound decisions along the way, and delivering a polished, production-ready result. Your work will ship to platforms serving millions of visitors, alongside a team recognized as one of the top enterprise WordPress practices in the world.

Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. For engineers in Latin America, that means real-time collaboration with US-based teams during your normal working day, compensation in USD, and a seat at the table on projects for globally recognized brands – all from wherever you work best. Together, we're shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

- Build features for enterprise-level WordPress solutions – custom Gutenberg blocks in React.js, plugins, and themes using modern HTML/CSS and well-structured PHP.

- Own tickets end-to-end: understand the requirements, make sound decisions when details are incomplete, and deliver reviewable pull requests with clear summaries of your approach, assumptions, and testing.

- Bring designs and user experiences to life by translating Figma designs and other project requirements into polished, responsive features and reusable components within WordPress themes and plugins.

- Leverage AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate implementation and debugging while critically validating every output before it reaches a pull request.

- Iterate on code review feedback from senior and lead engineers, absorbing patterns and best practices that sharpen your craft with every merge.

- Collaborate proactively and asynchronously in English with distributed teammates across engineering, design, and delivery.

What you will achieve:

- Within your first month, you'll have shipped merged, production-ready pull requests on a live client project, demonstrating that you can take written direction and run with it.

- By the 3-month mark, you'll be independently owning tickets from requirement to release, with review cycles getting shorter as your grasp of our conventions deepens.

- Your AI-assisted workflow will have measurably accelerated delivery on your project – without ever compromising the quality bar our clients expect.

- You'll have earned the trust of your engineering leads as a dependable contributor whose PRs are a pleasure to review.

- By the end of your contract, you'll have a portfolio of enterprise-grade work, sharpened skills, and a standing invitation for future collaboration.

About you:

- You have solid agency or consultancy experience building WordPress solutions for large-scale, enterprise projects – high-traffic sites, demanding clients, real deadlines.

- You're comfortable working across the web stack, including HTML, CSS, modern PHP, JavaScript, and the Gutenberg ecosystem, including building custom blocks with React.js. Bonus points if you've worked with our open-source tools, like ElasticPress or ClassifAI – tell us about it in your application.

- AI tools are already part of how you work: you use them to move faster, and you know exactly when they're wrong.

- You're passionate about sharpening your craft – you read best practices for fun, seek out code review, and never ship code you don't understand.

- You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken, and can confidently walk a reviewer through your decisions, assumptions, and tradeoffs.

- You're based in Latin America, and thrive on a distributed team, collaborating in real time with US time zones from the remote location of your choice.

Contractor Fee

Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Contractor fees are paid in USD.

Join our Contractor Pool 

This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles.

If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don't check all the boxes – please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy . Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here .

title: AI Senior Engineer (Graph)
description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. 

What you’ll be doing 

We are seeking someone who views the Knowledge Graph not just as a database, but as a living organism that requires constant care, feeding, and pruning. You understand that a RAG system is only as good as the data underlying it. You are intrigued by the complexity of ingesting massive, messy datasets and transforming them into clean, connected knowledge.

In short, someone who likes:

- Architecting Graph ETL: Designing and developing robust ETL pipelines specifically for graph ingestion. You aren't just dumping rows into tables; you are determining how disparate data sources connect, evolve, and relate in a graph structure.

- Data Ingestion at Scale: Managing high-volume data streams using tools like Kafka and implementing CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns to ensure the graph reflects real-time reality.

- Automated Graph Hygiene: Writing scripts and jobs for deduplication , orphan node detection , and data consistency checks. You take pride in a clean schema.

- Modeling Time: Handling complex temporal relationships (e.g., how property ownership or financial status changes over time) within the graph.

- Performance Tuning: Ensuring that as the graph grows (25k+ reports and beyond), the underlying query performance remains snappy through optimizing indexes and storage.

What we’re looking for 

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

- Neo4j Expertise (Must Have): 4+ years of hands-on experience. You master Cypher , schema design, and the operational side of managing a production graph.

- ETL & Pipeline Mastery: Strong background in building data pipelines. You know how to take raw data, clean it, and structure it for graph ingestion.

- Streaming & CDC: Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka and Change Data Capture methodologies to sync operational databases with the graph.

- Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for writing ingestion scripts, maintenance jobs, and custom graph algorithms.

- Data Integrity Focus: Experience implementing automated jobs for entity resolution , deduplication, and quality assurance.

Nice-to-Have: 

- C# Knowledge: Ability to read or contribute to C# codebases.

- Domain Experience: Prior work in Finance or Real Estate sectors.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

- To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

- Payments made in USD.

- 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

- Wellness + Remote Stipend

- AI Voucher

About Able 

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. Unlike a typical startup where you might spend half your time in meetings and the other half fixing Jira tickets, at MixRank you’ll challenge yourself with difficult technical problems that help you grow as an individual. title: Senior Software Engineer, Canvas Core
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Canvas Core team builds and maintains the foundational platform that powers Mural’s visual thinking experience. This includes the infinite canvas, key editor components, document editing behaviors, asset management, real-time collaboration, and the systems that enable fast, reliable, and intuitive interaction on the canvas.

We’re also responsible for the Mural UI, the real-time message protocol that enables seamless remote collaboration, and the developer-friendly APIs that internal teams use to build features like diagramming, workshops, presentations, integrations, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

Our mission is to ensure the Mural editor is fast, reliable, intuitive, and easy to build on.

We prioritize performance, simplicity, developer experience, and platform quality, enabling teams across the company to ship quickly and safely on top of Canvas Core.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and improve the Canvas platform so that the Mural editor remains reliable, high-performing, and intuitive for our users.

You’ll work on the systems that power real-time collaboration, shared document editing, spatial interactions, rendering and interaction performance, asset management, developer APIs, and AI-enabled product capabilities across the Mural editor.

Your role will be to reduce platform complexity, improve the quality and speed of Canvas development, and help teams ship high-quality editor experiences quickly and safely. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn ambiguous product and platform problems into clear, maintainable technical solutions.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead by example through strong technical execution, thoughtful design, high-quality implementation, and collaborative problem-solving. They help raise the bar for their team through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring, documentation, and pragmatic improvements to engineering practices.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own and deliver new Canvas platform capabilities and improvements from problem definition through implementation, release, measurement, and iteration

Partner with Product and Design to shape high-quality user experiences, balancing pragmatic technical delivery with long-term platform needs

Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows as part of your engineering practice to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure work effectively

Strengthen the team through technical design reviews, demos, code reviews, mentoring, and improvements to engineering practices

Build and evolve canvas systems with rich document and object models, including hierarchical scene or document structures, spatial indexing and querying, layout behavior, asset management, and selection mechanics

- 
Work on large-scale concurrent and real-time collaboration systems that keep shared documents synchronized across users, contributing to design decisions around event ordering, latency, conflict handling, and failure-mode management

- 
Help design, build, and integrate AI-enabled product capabilities where they intersect with the canvas, document model, real-time collaboration systems, or developer platform

- 
Improve performance through profiling, bottleneck analysis, architectural simplification, targeted optimization, and moving expensive work out of critical interaction paths so systems remain responsive as document complexity and user activity scale

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- 
Fluency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with familiarity in React, Node.js, or comparable modern frameworks

- 
6+ years building and shipping large-scale production software as part of an agile engineering team

- 
Strong engineering judgment, with experience designing and delivering scalable, reliable, high-performance systems and developer-facing abstractions that balance simplicity, developer experience, and long-term maintainability

- 
Experience designing clean API contracts and service boundaries, including thoughtful data models, versioning, validation, error handling, documentation, and long-term maintainability

- 
Experience building distributed, concurrent, collaborative, or low-latency systems, such as collaboration tools, MMO games, shared-state systems, messaging protocols, or other low-latency user experiences, with familiarity across synchronization, consistency, event ordering, latency, failure modes, and performance trade-offs

Familiarity with parallel processing, off-main-thread architectures, rendering pipelines, background computation, or other multithreaded systems is a plus

Practical experience using AI-assisted tools to prototype, implement, test, document, and measure engineering work

Communication and collaboration skills, with a low-ego approach to working with Product, Design, and Engineering, and the ability to contribute meaningfully to technical discussions, collaborate across teams, and help improve team engineering practices

Comfort operating in high-growth, fast-paced environments or scale-ups is a plus
